rels.sql: WITH output_domain AS ( SELECT 0 AS revenue ), partial_aggs AS (SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * l_discount) AS revenue FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l_discount >= 0.03 - 0.01 AND (l_discount <= 0.03 + 0.01 AND l_quantity < 24)) SELECT COALESCE(p.revenue, o.revenue) AS revenue, CASE WHEN p.revenue IS NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS dummy_tag FROM output_domain o LEFT JOIN partial_aggs p ON true
